name: pangu-505b-int8-4p1d-omnicache-v2
description: Companion to xiaoyiclaw_505B_DSA_A3_INT8_4P8_1D16_omnicache Ansible. 4 single-node P (TP16), 1 two-node D (DP32), OmniCache V2 TCP. ENABLE_OMNI_CACHE=0 bypasses legacy setup; OMNI_ENABLE_OMNI_CACHE=1 enables V2.

group_configs.description: Replace image/resource IDs and MODEL_PATH. Image must include matching OmniInfer, OmniCache V2 and built native libraries. Expose writable 2 MiB hugetlbfs at /dev/hugepages: 1200 GiB per P node, 600 GiB per D node.

unit_configs.cmd:
KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG=$(python3 -c 'import json, os, subprocess
config = json.loads(os.environ["OMNI_CACHE_V2_KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG"])
topology = subprocess.check_output(
    ["python3", "/workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/get_node_ip_list.py"],
    text=True,
).strip()
groups = [group.split(",") for group in topology.split(";")]
if [len(group) for group in groups] != [1, 1, 1, 1, 2]:
    raise ValueError("Expected four single-node P groups and one two-node D group")
pod_ip = os.environ["POD_IP"]
if sum(group.count(pod_ip) for group in groups) != 1:
    raise ValueError("POD_IP must occur exactly once in the ModelArts topology")
extra = config["kv_connector_extra_config"]
if config["kv_role"] == "kv_producer":
    config["engine_id"] = str([group[0] for group in groups[:-1]].index(pod_ip))
    extra["ox_advertised_endpoints"] = pod_ip + ":16077"
else:
    config["engine_id"] = str(len(groups) - 1)
    extra["host_memory_node_dp_rank_start"] = groups[-1].index(pod_ip) * 16
    extra["host_memory_node_dp_size"] = 16
logger.info(json.dumps(config, separators=(",", ":")))') && bash /workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/proxy.sh --core-num 16 --start-core-index 16 --subrequest-output-buffer-size 10M --omni-proxy-pd-policy sequential --omni-proxy-max-batch-num-token 20480 --omni-proxy-prefill-max-num-seqs 3 --omni-proxy-decode-max-num-seqs 3 && bash /workspace/omniinfer/tools/deploy/model_arts/prefill.sh --max-model-len 262144 --block-size 128 --no-disable-hybrid-kv-cache-manager --enable-expert-parallel --max-num-seqs 3 --enable-prompt-tokens-details --enable-chunked-prefill --dtype bfloat16 --kv-cache-dtype li_int8_ds_mla --reasoning-parser pangu --enable-auto-tool-choice --tool-call-parser pangu --reasoning-config '{"reasoning_start_str":"<think>","reasoning_end_str":"</think>"}' --mamba-block-size 128 --enable-prefix-caching --speculative_config '{"method":"mtp","num_speculative_tokens":3}' --max-num-batched-tokens 30720 --enforce-eager --additional-config '{"enable_low_latency":true,"enable_omni_cache":true}' --kv-transfer-config "$KV_TRANSFER_CONFIG" && sleep infinity
unit_configs.name: prefill-0
